rows.explainer:
PATH proposes using mebendazole as the touchpoint for the PMC dose 5. 
https://givewell.app.box.com/file/1048240927652?s=yplk28thd13zmdlsrnrx5rptswb21pf7

The WHO immunization database does not contain estimates for mebendazole coverage in DRC, so here we assume a slightly lower estimate of coverage than the other vaccines.

rows.label: Best guess of actual EPI coverage (Dose 6)
rows.explainer:
PATH proposes using MCV2 (a meningococcal vaccine) as the touchpoint for PMC dose 6. 
https://givewell.app.box.com/file/1048240927652?s=yplk28thd13zmdlsrnrx5rptswb21pf7

Here we assume a slightly lower estimate of coverage than the other vaccines. The WHO immunization database does not contain recent estimates of meningococcal vaccine coverage in DRC. The database only shows the official reported coverage of the meningococcal A conjugate vaccine for the year 2016. 
https://immunizationdata.who.int/pages/coverage/men.html?CODE=COD&YEAR=

rows.label: Adjustment for drug combination used
rows.explainer: 7 of the 9 trials in the modified analysis used SP (see Section 1.1.3 IPTi SP), the IPTi drug of choice. The effect size on the SP subgroup (0.78) is very close to the effect size including all 9 trials (0.76), so we don't adjust for the drug combination used in the studies.

Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
